translations.web: You shall fear Yahweh your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.
translations.bsb: You are to fear the LORD your God and serve Him. Hold fast to Him and take your oaths in His name.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
translations.asv: Thou shalt fear Jehovah thy God; him shalt thou serve; and to him shalt thou cleave, and by his name shalt thou swear.
